display.purpose: Wordmark and top-level page titles. No separate display face — the sans, larger, tracked tight.

body.purpose: The global default, set once on html/body at 13px. Everything inherits it.

label.purpose: Table column headers and field labels. Uppercase, tracked 0.03em.

micro-label.purpose: Badges, pills, status chips. Uppercase 10px/700 tracked 0.07em.

numeric.purpose: Geist Mono. Marks a value as machine-derived — score, ID, code. Never prose.

shadows.name: 2xs
shadows.purpose: Resting lift on cards and inline panels.

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Raised containers; hover response on interactive cards.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, popovers, menus — anything overlaying siblings.

shadows.name: lg
shadows.purpose: Modals and dialogs, always over the overlay scrim.

shadows.name: nav-active
shadows.purpose: The active top-nav underline. Emphasis without a thicker border.

shadows.name: sticky-head
shadows.purpose: The rule under a sticky table header — a border-bottom does not paint reliably while rows composite over it.

shadows.name: overlay-scrim
shadows.purpose: Modal backdrop. Must be heavier in dark or it vanishes.

motion.name: duration-exit
motion.purpose: Fast — the old thing is already stale.

motion.name: duration-move
motion.purpose: 2.7x exit. Position carries continuity; opacity is only a veil.

motion.name: icon-spring
motion.purpose: The one overshoot spring behind all sixteen icon hover motions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The action of a surface. One per region.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background 0.18s, opacity 0.18s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, #006b4f); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00583f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #006b4f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary and cancel actions. Hairline border, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #171717); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2e2); transition: background 0.18s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--card, #fff); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #006b4f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Verdict Badge
components.description: The Analyst's decision. Soft 8% fill of its own signal color; never appears without its evidence nearby.
components.html: BidWatchNo-Bid
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-badge-bid { color: var(--primary, #006b4f); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #006b4f) 8%, var(--background, #fff)); } .ds-badge-watch { color: var(--watch, #b45309); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--watch, #b45309) 8%, var(--background, #fff)); } .ds-badge-nobid { color: var(--muted-foreground, #6b6b6b); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted-foreground, #6b6b6b) 8%, var(--background, #fff)); }

components.name: Metadata Pill
components.description: Categorical metadata carrying no judgement — NAICS, set-aside, agency.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted-foreground, #6b6b6b); background: var(--muted-surface, #f4f4f4); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2e2); padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; margin-right: 6px; }

components.name: Risk Meter
components.description: Three bars whose lit count IS the level, so it reads pre-attentively without the word. The physical form of the show-your-evidence rule.
components.html:
RiskMedium
  • HighNo citable CPARS for this scope
  • LowResponse window is 21 days
components.css: .ds-risk { font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2e2); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--muted-surface, #f4f4f4); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04); } .ds-risk-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-risk-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted-foreground, #6b6b6b); } .ds-risk-bars { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-risk-bars i { width: 20px; height: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--border, #e2e2e2); } .ds-risk-bars.ds-r-medium i.on { background: var(--watch, #b45309); } .ds-risk-level { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-risk-level.ds-r-medium { color: var(--watch, #b45309); } .ds-risk-list { list-style: none; margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--foreground, #171717); } .ds-risk-list li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2e2); } .ds-risk-sev { font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-risk-sev.ds-s-high { color: var(--watch, #b45309); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--watch, #b45309) 8%, var(--background, #fff)); } .ds-risk-sev.ds-s-low { color: var(--muted-foreground, #6b6b6b); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted-foreground, #6b6b6b) 8%, var(--background, #fff)); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The green focus border IS the focus indicator; no ring is drawn.
components.css: .ds-input-search { font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; color: var(--foreground, #171717); background: var(--background, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2e2); border-radius: 5px; padding: 7px 11px; width: 260px; transition: border-color 0.18s; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #6b6b6b); } .ds-input-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary, #006b4f); }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: 56px bar. Active item is marked by an inset green underline, never a border.
components.html: Collecct.
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; height: 56px; padding: 0 18px; background: var(--background, #fff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2e2); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-brand { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--foreground, #171717); } .ds-dot { color: var(--primary, #006b4f); } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-item { font: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 14px; border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #6b6b6b); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s, color 0.16s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--foreground, #171717); background: var(--muted-surface, #f4f4f4); } .ds-nav-item.ds-on { color: var(--foreground, #171717); background: var(--muted-surface, #f4f4f4); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary, #006b4f); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006b4f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table thead th { position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--muted-surface, #f4f4f4); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--border, #e2e2e2); padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted-foreground, #6b6b6b); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table tbody td { padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2e2); color: var(--foreground, #171717); } .ds-table tbody tr { transition: background 0.13s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--muted-surface, #f4f4f4); } .ds-table .ds-num { text-align: right; } .ds-table .ds-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview:
Collecct looks like government-contracting paperwork that someone finally made comfortable to work in. It borrows the discipline of the source material — ruled tables, uppercase micro-labels, tabular figures that line up down a column, official restraint in color — and then removes the parts that make federal documents miserable: the cramped margins, the undifferentiated wall of text, the sense that nothing on the page is more important than anything else.

The result is a quiet, dense, high-information surface. Body text sits at 13px and micro labels at 10–11px, because a capture rep is reading a hundred opportunities, not an article. Nearly everything is neutral: white or near-black paper, one hairline rule, one tonal step. Into that neutrality, exactly one warm color enters — a deep forest green (#006b4f) that means go. When you see green, a decision has been made or an action is available. Nothing else in the system is allowed to be green.

Depth is soft and layered rather than flat: cards, panels, and popovers sit on the paper as real objects with a resting shadow, and the shadow scale grows with how far off the page a thing is meant to be. Motion is fast and restrained — a 150ms exit, a 210ms enter, a 400ms move, because position is what carries continuity and opacity is only a veil.
keyCharacteristics: Two typefaces, both Geist: sans for everything readable, mono for every number.
Neutral-dominant palette; one accent, one alarm, one caution.
Tabular figures globally — every count, currency, and score aligns.
Uppercase, wide-tracked micro-labels as the organizing device.
5px corners as the default; pills only for status, never for containers.
Light and dark are peers, not a theme and its afterthought.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: The accent covers ≤10% of any screen. It marks decisions and actions — nothing decorative, no accent-tinted surfaces, no green section headers. A Bid badge is only legible as a signal because the surrounding page has no other green in it.

rules.name: The Ink-Is-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: A color that works as a background does not automatically work as lettering. Green text uses --bid-ink, green fills use --primary; border-color on a focus state uses --ring. Writing color: var(--accent) is the bug this rule exists to prevent — it renders at 2.5:1 in dark mode.

rules.name: The Reserved Signal Rule
rules.body: bid, nobid, watch, and the deadline ramp are semantic tokens. Never borrow one for a chart series, an illustration, or a mood.

rules.name: The Soft-Fill Rule
rules.body: Status backgrounds are the signal color mixed 8% into the page (color-mix(in oklab, var(--bid) 8%, var(--background))) — never a raw tint constant, so they stay correct in both modes automatically.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums is set once on body, not per-cell. Almost nothing here is running prose, and every count, dollar column, and score needs figures that line up. Do not override it.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is not a style choice; it marks a value as machine-derived — a score, an ID, a code. Never set prose in the mono, and never set a score in the sans.

rules.name: The Two-Case Rule
rules.body: Text is sentence case or uppercase-tracked, never Title Case. Title Case in a govcon UI reads as a document heading and fights the real hierarchy.

rules.name: The Frame Rule
rules.body: The page never scrolls. New surfaces get their own scroll container inside the frame; anything that makes body scroll is a bug.

rules.name: The Distance Rule
rules.body: Pick a shadow by how far the element is from the page, never by how important it is. Importance is expressed in type and color; distance is expressed in shadow.

rules.name: The Paired-Depth Rule
rules.body: A shadow never replaces the hairline rule. Layered surfaces carry both — the rule defines the edge, the shadow defines the gap.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every border is 1px in the line token. If a divider needs more weight, the answer is a tonal surface change or an inset shadow, never a thicker stroke.

rules.name: The Verdict-With-Evidence Rule
rules.body: A bid_decision, priority_score, or risk_level never appears alone. Wherever one is shown, its factors or rationale must be one interaction away at most — hover, adjacent, or expandable in place.

dos: Do keep the accent scarce — buttons, active nav, focus, and Bid verdicts. Everything else is neutral.
Do set every number in Geist Mono and leave tabular-nums alone.
Do use uppercase, 0.03–0.07em tracked micro-labels as the organizing device for dense regions.
Do build status fills with color-mix(in oklab, var(--signal) 8%, var(--background)) so both themes resolve automatically.
Do give every new surface its own scroll container; the frame never scrolls.
Do author against the semantic tokens (--ink, --line, --surface-2), never raw hex — the light/dark pairing lives in the token, not in your rule.
Do pick shadows by distance from the page, and pair them with the hairline rule.
Do draw emphasis with an inset shadow (inset 0 -2px 0) rather than a heavier border.
donts: Don't reuse bid, nobid, watch, or the deadline ramp as a chart series color.
Don't introduce a third typeface, or a display face. Headings are the sans, larger, with negative tracking.
Don't use pill radius on containers — pills mean status.
Don't use borders thicker than 1px, dashed dividers, or double rules.
Don't write Title Case in UI copy.
Don't tint a surface with the accent, or use green as a section-header color.
Don't style scrollbars per-pane; they are defined once globally.
Don't add a border-bottom to a sticky table header — use box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0.
Don't ship a verdict, score, or risk level without the evidence behind it.
Don't write color: var(--accent) — green lettering uses --bid-ink, green fills use --primary.
